body:
# PatternWrap

AE2 Pattern Encoding Terminal extension - Automatically converts Processing Pattern outputs into Written Books.

## Features

- WB toggle button inside the Pattern Encoding Terminal
- When enabled, automatically wraps the output as a Written Book when transferring processing patterns
- Input items are preserved and will not be cleared
- Toggle button is visible in both **EMI** and **JEI** recipe screens (only appears when opened from the Encoding Terminal)
- EMI and JEI can be installed together without conflicts

## Usage

1. Open the AE2 Pattern Encoding Terminal
2. Click the WB button to enable book mode
3. Open a processing pattern recipe in EMI/JEI
4. Click transfer - the output will be wrapped as a Written Book

## Environment Requirements

| Dependency  | Required | Version |
|-------------|----------|---------|
| NeoForge    | Yes      | ≥21     |
| AE2         | Yes      | 19.x    |
| EMI         | No       | 1.1.x   |
| JEI         | No       | 19.x    |
